property_summary: For any caller, setOwner succeeds only when the caller is the deployer/admin and otherwise reverts leaving owner unchanged; the inverted check makes every non-admin succeed, violating the rule.
change_summary: Invert the access check to `msg.sender != admin`, so everyone except the admin can call setOwner and the owner gets overwritten by non-admins.
